We are very proud and excited to extend an invite to another one of our favorite fall films,
MARTHA MARCY MAY MARLENE. This film must be seen, and Elizabeth Olsen's
performance is a revelation. The film is screening as part of the festival, and we are hosting our
own private party with the filmmakers and stars of the film afterwards. We know it's a bit on the
later side, but this film is worth it. We hope you can join us...




You are invited to join



Elizabeth Olsen and

Filmmaker Sean Durkin

along with cast members John Hawkes and Hugh Dancy



at the New York Film Festival screening of



MARTHA MARCY MAY MARLENE

Elizabeth Olsen stars in director Sean Durkin's psychological thriller, MARTHA MARCY MAY
MARLENE, about a young woman who undergoes an explosive crisis of identity after escaping
the confines of a rural cult-like fanning community. Trapped by unsettling flashes of memories
from the past and visions of a perilous future, she becomes taken over by an unsettling sense of
fear, leaving her consumed by paranoia and a mysterious burden of guilt.
